answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade, slashed if peers prove fake activity. One identity, one bond: creating a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds, so a Sybil farm pays real capital per copy. Like an island where every trader must moor at the same jetty and pay harbour dues, while honest agents earn their bond back — the oasis of trust stays costly to flood and cheap for real participants to enter.
